4281.title: Touch activation permits unpinning
4281.rootCauseOneLine: Time-based touch drag activation permits a small cross-section movement to invoke the unpin action.
4281.proposedFix: Choose an explicit mobile reorder initiation contract, then gate touch dragging on it.
4281.caveats: Isolated DOM/action-boundary reproduction; physical-phone frequency and database persistence were not measured. No PR because mobile reorder initiation needs a product decision.
